Needs changes before merge.

The reference heights now use the tool axis during generation. The new tests detect the old height and section errors. Fixed-height compatibility and the shipped 4-axis program tests pass.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2418` against upstream main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`. This main commit is already an ancestor of the PR head. The trial merge reports `Already up to date`. No GitHub runner was used.

Build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run -j 6` | Passed |
| App library tests | 362 passed; 1 existing heavy-lane test ignored |
| `tilt_heights` | 3 passed |
| `tilt` | 8 passed |
| `tilt_basis_compat` | 5 passed |
| `tilt_a180` | 2 passed |
| `opframe_seam` | 8 passed |
| `first_4axis_part` | 4 passed |
| `heights` | 11 passed |
| `heights_fixtures` | 8 passed |
| `heights_selection` | 9 passed |
| `area_controls` | 13 passed |
| `area_overhead` | 1 passed |
| `wcs_tilt` | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -j 6 --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The selected tests total 436 passes. I read the quick gate plan. I did not run its full 247 steps.

I repeated two mutations independently:

- Restore the setup height resolver in `collect_job`: all three new tests fail. The slot clearances become 25 instead of 15, and 17 instead of 21.
- Pass no frame to `section_z_of` in `collect_job`: the contour test fails with `no material at z = 14.000`.

I restored both mutations. All three original tests then pass. No goldens changed in this PR. No `crates/ui` file changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs:222` and `crates/app/src/operation/heights_sel.rs:168`: use the same tilted height resolver during command validation. Generation now uses `resolve_params_folded`, but `depth_sane` still uses `resolve_params`. This rejects a legal tilted cut when the heights use different references. I confirmed this with a temporary test using the PR's `bench` and `slot` helpers. Use `bench(12.0, 30.0, 5.0, -5.0)`, A = -90, B = 0, and origin = [0, 0, 0]. Keep Top = Top of stock + 0. Set Bottom = Fixed 10.5. The new resolver gives Top = 11 and Bottom = 10.5. However, `CreateOperation::new` rejects the operation because validation reads the setup stock top as 10. Route depth validation through the checked tilt frame. Add a test for creation and editing with mixed references.

The reproduction fails with:

```text
Invalid("a Slot operation must cut downward: its top height resolves below its bottom height (check the From references)")
```

The temporary reproduction was removed. The review worktree has no code changes.

The UI work remains in #2416, as the PR body states. This review does not verify that display change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Whole-model and Stock-source pocket island ladders now use `fold_height` for Top and Bottom. The pins are `tilted_whole_model_reference_pocket_preserves_part_islands` and `tilted_stock_reference_pocket_preserves_part_islands` in `tilt_heights.rs`. Each checks the tool-axis bottom and no Gouge warnings. Reverting each source's fix independently makes its pin fail with 16 Gouge warnings. Restoring each fix makes its pin pass.

2. Depth validation now uses `resolve_params_folded` through the checked tilt frame. The pins are `tilted_mixed_reference_depth_is_accepted_on_creation`, `tilted_mixed_reference_depth_is_accepted_on_editing`, and `tilted_upward_mixed_reference_depth_is_refused_on_creation_and_editing`. Reverting the resolver makes all three fail. Restoring it makes them pass.

New head: `302b097254569c239d5d5e3f28ff06625080b92c`.

All 8 tilt-height tests pass. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes all 247 steps: 2,106 tests passed, 21 ignored. App clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` passes. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review these two findings on the new head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the new head. Both blockers from the earlier reviews are corrected.

- Command depth validation uses the checked tilt frame. Creation and editing accept the legal mixed-reference depth. Both commands refuse the upward cut.
- Whole-model and Stock-source pockets use the same height resolver for island planes and generation levels. Both tests protect the part islands.
- Fixed heights and upright operations keep their previous behaviour. No golden files changed. No `crates/ui` files changed, so this PR needs no screenshots.

I repeated three mutations. I restored each change after its test.

1. Restore the setup resolver in `depth_sane`: all three mixed-reference validation tests fail.
2. Restore the setup resolver in `whole_model_pocket`: its island test fails with 16 Gouge warnings.
3. Restore the setup resolver in `stock_pocket`: its island test fails with 16 Gouge warnings.

With all changes restored, all eight `tilt_heights` tests pass. The worktree has no code changes.
The unchanged CL, conformance, solid-law and first 4-axis goldens pass. There are no moved goldens to inspect.

Requested before merge: none.
